## Geopolitics

### Houthis escalate attacks on Saudi Arabian infrastructure
<span class="imp imp-3" title="Importance 3/5" aria-label="Importance 3 of 5"><i class="on"></i><i class="on"></i><i class="on"></i><i></i><i></i></span> Yemen's Houthis claimed drone and missile attacks on Saudi Aramco's Jazan refinery and Yemen's Mocha port on August 9, 2026, killing seven and threatening to reignite Yemen's civil war amid wider regional conflict.

<ul class="takeaways">
<li>Jazan refinery processes 400,000 barrels of crude oil per day; fire reported, no casualties there</li>
<li>Mocha port attack killed 7 (4 troops, 3 civilians) and injured 15 civilians</li>
<li>Houthis say attacks were retaliation for Saudi drone incursions into Hajjah and Saada</li>
<li>Strikes came two days after Saudi Arabia signed a defense pact with Turkey and Pakistan</li>
<li>Escalation follows 2022 truce and coincides with US-Israeli military action against Iran since Feb 2026</li>
</ul>
